title: I'm Not Here To Complain Publicly (Builder Mode)
style: uplifting indie rock turning to anthemic, building from acoustic guitar to full band, male sincere lead vocal, female harmony build, hopeful brass section, 96 BPM, builder-anthem, dignified-strong
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I didn't quit — I built around it
Moved my workflow off the broken Pro
VPS running on the API direct
No browser, no Desktop, just the flow

[Pre-Chorus]
Claude Code on the API holds the line
The model works — the surface was the crime

[Chorus]
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
I'M A BUILDER — STILL TYPING THROUGH
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
THE WORK IS WHAT I'M LOYAL TO
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
AI HEROES DATABASE LISTING
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
FORWARD-LOOKING — NO RESISTING

[Verse 2]
Deployed two new sites on the same day
Mosoko and Kervalon — two hundred OK
Twenty-five new records in the database
Zero context loss, zero crashes, zero re-base
This is what Claude should be — the API steady
Builder mode, persistent, ready

[Bridge — spoken]
The ask is a goodwill gesture on the outage portion.
Not a full refund — the choice to keep pushing was mine.
Just the charges where the service was verifiably down.
No drama. Just a builder. Just the line.

[Final Chorus]
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
I'M A BUILDER — STILL ON THE WIRE
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
THE LINE STILL HOLDS — THE LINE STILL FIRE
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
JUST RESOLVE IT HUMAN TO HUMAN
I'M NOT HERE TO COMPLAIN PUBLICLY
THE BUILDER STAYS — THE BUILDER LANE TRUE'IN
